reason.zh: 沉浸式主线与支线把角色塑造得很扎实，开放世界也鼓励你自由探索；你的选择会推动关系与走向。
reason.en: A richly told main story and side quests make the characters feel vivid, and the open world invites self-directed exploration; your choices meaningfully affect.

reason.zh: 以对话与调查驱动的叙事为核心，角色与世界观非常有吸引力；不同选项能改变剧情走向与互动关系。
reason.en: Dialogue- and investigation-driven storytelling at its core, with highly engaging characters and worldbuilding; your choices can steer the plot and outcomes.

reason.zh: 史诗级叙事与人物情感贯穿始终，剧情厚度很高；同时拥有大量可自由游玩与发现的内容。
reason.en: Epic storytelling with deeply human character moments throughout, delivering strong narrative weight; plus plenty of space to roam and discover on your own.
